edits.old: - Not met or not shown: a hot Bazel no-op under 10 s (not measurable on this host: 45 min in the capacity queue; planner skip and quiet grant are in the tree to fix the two causes, the measurement repeats after batch 4b); graph builder under 2 GB (index views 1.7 GB, native discovery; the index-chunk batch reaches 2.9 GB peak, pending gate); graph generation under 2 min after a larger peer edit.
edits.new: - Not met or not shown (first honest baseline, bench2-g, 10-26 18:54-19:36, quiet window, 32 GB / 10-core Mac, Bazel, before the evening batches): a hot course no-op takes 60 / 77 / 83 s (target 10 s) and none of it is Bazel (0.4-0.5 s, 0 actions re-executed): graph freshness 9-27 s, tool-setup (Bazel slot, planner, implementation capture) 32-48 s, dependency verification 5-6 s, admission 3-7 s, capacity wait 0-19 s (every hot run asked for 7168 MB, 10x its measured footprint of 0.67-0.73 GiB; RSS 2.1-2.25 GiB). A one-line course edit takes 506 s instead of 60 s (graph 307 s for one re-inferred project, tool-setup 85 s, execution 60 s: 1 action executed, 6 cache hits) and peaks at a footprint of 3.0 GiB (RSS 5.1 GiB). The dashboard prime failed after 909 s with `Refusing to wait` behind the lease of a human's running dashboard. Not measured: peer edits, the revert of an edit, print, the 3-agent scenario. Also not met: graph builder under 2 GB (index views 1.7 GB, native discovery; the index-chunk batch reaches 2.9 GB peak, pending gate) and graph generation under 2 min after a larger peer edit. Re-measure with `repo bench compare` on reports of the same host class.
